{{Quote|Take Kessan's Landing. Frontier town, not far from here. Not much to look at, and folks keep to themselves.|[[Jendan Blyes]]|<ref name="TOR:AHH">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|A Helping Hand|Ord Mantell}}</ref>}}
'''Kessan's Landing''' was a small island located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TOR:codex" /> During the [[Third Galactic War]], the island was the site of a resurgence of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="TOR:AHH" />
{{Loc-stub}}
